name: Ninja's Blades
description:
When this artifact enters the battlefield, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token, then attach this to it.

Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and is a Ninja in addition to its other types.

Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage, draw a card, then discard a card. The opponent loses life equal to the discarded card's mana value.

Equip {2}
assumptions: Rendered the cost/target/attach activated ability (3.0) using the word "Equip" — the edges never spell out that keyword, but the shape (cost + target + self-attach) has no other standard rendering.

Phrased the life-loss clause as "the opponent" (two-player frame) — owner:opp with no target flag means automatic, not chosen, but the schema doesn't distinguish "the opponent" from "each opponent" for a bare opp owner.
Collapsed the three job-select edges (self-scoped ETB listen, hero-token creation, self-attach) into one sentence rather than three.
couldNotDerive: Whether Equip's target is restricted to "creature you control" — the target flag marks it as chosen, but no controller restriction is separately encoded.
notes: Retest after adding the self registry (on top of the earlier hero-token subtype fix). The card's own subtype "Equipment" — previously an accepted gap since nothing modeled a permanent's own subtype — now also resolves correctly via the registry, same as "Hero" did for the token. Mana cost, type line, +1/+1/Ninja modifier+tagger, granted draw/discard/life-loss trigger, and Equip {2} all correct.
